removals._doc: ⚑ S426 (UiB job 35 Part D, Act III beats 13–14; his 20 Nov 16-17: "the removal should be seen happening"; "4 items could not be…" is confusing). THE REMOVAL, SEEN WHERE IT HAPPENS: in the chat. With the kit closed, the group opens wide again on the monitor and the platform's bar lies at the top of the thread, in its blue (`bar`); then, one message at a time, slowly enough to watch, the platform's outline around a Malta message, `removing…`, the bubble greyed, and folded into one line (s3_maiden.json `removedLine`): the card first, then Bea's lines, then Susan's. The forwards land faster (a message every 0.75 s): the review greys the first two and cannot keep up; the bar says `lost`. The platform's own voice (no Lambient). The removals are the piece's inference (ARTICLE_COMPANION §7g); the vote is documented (Act LV of 2016).
